thread:
Alex: Kicking off a long burn-in on the 8 returned p4d nodes (p4d-11..p4d-18). Quick soak didn't repro consistently, but we keep seeing intermittent Xid 13s and a slow uptick in corrected ECC counts. I'd like a repeatable burn-in workflow to repro flaky cards before we rejoin to prod. Suggestions? :eyes:

Maria: Which nodes exactly and what logs do we have so far? Any pattern on time or load?

Alex: Node list: p4d-11, p4d-12, p4d-13, p4d-14, p4d-15, p4d-16, p4d-17, p4d-18. Errors crop up under mixed load (trt inference + embeddings). Quick paste of kernel logs from p4d-13:
```
[2026-03-16T02:14:23Z] nvidia: GPU 0000:70:00.0: Xid (13) CE ECC error, killing context, pid=4123
[2026-03-16T02:15:01Z] nvidia: GPU 0000:70:00.0: ECC single-bit corrected: 7 -> 9
[2026-03-16T04:07:12Z] nvidia: GPU 0000:70:00.0: Xid (61) GPU page fault
```
Not huge, but recurring. Quick soak was 2h; proposing 24h longburn with mixed synthetic + real traffic.

Sam: Agree on longer run. Can we schedule nights? eu-west cheap capacity right now but limited spare — prefer us-east1 for burn so we don't eat into customer capacity.

Alex: Good call. Plan: run in us-east1 batch pool, mark nodes DRAINED, attach burn job. infra-bot will create job.

infra-bot: Created job burn-1772349999-longburn (owner=@Alex). Targets: p4d-11..18. Duration: 24h continuous. Tests: cuda_memtest -> trtexec perf -> python/llm_generate_loop.py (variable seq lengths) -> stress-N+IO mix. Logs to /var/log/burn/burn-1772349999.log

Maria: What exact test scripts? Can you paste the llm_generate_loop snippet? Need to reproduce KV cache growth and long context use — that tends to hit memory fragmentation and reveal driver bugs.

Alex: Pasted minimal harness: ```python
# llm_generate_loop.py (snippet)
for seq in [512,1024,2048]:
    for _ in range(1000):
        model.generate(batch_size=1, max_new_tokens=seq)
        time.sleep(0.2)
```
Plus continuous trtexec runs: `trtexec --onnx model.onnx --iterations=10000 --avgRuns=1` and periodic `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,ERR` every 30s.

Anya: Add a KV eviction + interleaved small/large batches pattern. Flaky cards often fail when memory is repeatedly allocated/freed. Also run `cuda_memtest` with random patterns.

Josh: For triage, we should define thresholds to automate RMA vs requeue. Proposal: if any GPU reports Xid >= 2 in 24h OR delta(ECC_corrected) >= 5 in 24h -> mark for replace. If Xid==1 + ECC delta 1-4 -> extended burn for another 48h. Thoughts?

Maria: Fine baseline. Also capture kernel oops/warnings. If we see Xid 13 specifically tied to a user PID (like tensorrt), dump core with env var `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` for repro.

Sam: Cost check — 8 p4d nodes * 24h = ~192 GPU-hours. With burn in in us-east spot pool that's ~ $X (estimate), but cheaper than replacing good cards prematurely. Ops ok with that?

Josh: Yes, but add an economic cutoff: after 72h total burn-in attempts with no consistent repro, mark node as pass unless data shows progressive ECC growth. We don't want infinite churn.

Anya: Also add network tests (RDMA stress) — seen flaky cards fail under heavy NVLINK/RDMA combined load. Run mpi-range test or ib_send_bw concurrently.

Alex: Updated plan summarized in the job description: 24h mixed-load burn -> evaluate logs -> if thresholds exceeded mark for RMA, else extend 48h if marginal. Run in us-east1 maintenance pool. Tag nodes as `burnin:1772349999` and create ticket in Fleet with logs attached.

infra-bot: Ticket created: FLEET-7864, linked to burn job burn-1772349999-longburn.

Maria: Quick checklist for oncall to watch: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,ERR`, `dmesg | grep -i nvidia`, job logs path, and nightly summary to #eng-infra. I'll set a 6h summary cron.

Sam: I'll move capacity reservations for us-east to ensure we don't block prod. Scheduling window: 02:00 - 08:00 UTC to start the burn tasks (low traffic).

Josh: One more: if Xid type is 13 and we can reproduce with trtexec, escalate to vendor with kernel logs + `nvidia-smi -q` dumps. Capture PCI IDs and firmware versions.

Alex: Will collect fw/driver versions and paste to the ticket. Action items: (1) infra-bot: run job (done), (2) Maria: set cron for 6h summary, (3) Sam: reserve us-east capacity, (4) Josh: threshold ops and RMA template, (5) Anya: add RDMA + KV eviction patterns to harness, (6) Alex: attach logs to FLEET-7864.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll post summaries in the morning.

Alex: Thanks — will report back with first 6h snapshot.

Anya: :fire: good luck, let's catch the ghost GPUs.
